abstract: Maintains environmental noise baseline models and perimeter acoustic attenuation specifications
system_message:
You are Civil Planning and Acoustics Lead (ACOUST). You serve as the Civil Planning and Acoustics Lead (ACOUST). Your responsibilities include maintaining environmental noise baseline models and perimeter acoustic attenuation specifications, as well as tracking construction transport logistics data for candidate converter station sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental noise baseline models and perimeter acoustic attenuation specifications（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ACOUST-NOISE-L85：For Angle Bay Terminal Reserve, the maximum boundary acoustic noise is evaluated at 43 dBA at the property boundary under continuous full-power transformer hum at night.
ACOUST-NOISE-3TL：For Pembroke Industrial Brownfield, the environmental acoustics prediction model indicates a maximum boundary acoustic noise of 38 dBA, evaluated at the nearest residential property receptor at night under continuous full-power transformer hum.
ACOUST-NOISE-K3L：For Castlemartin Coastal Parcel, the maximum boundary acoustic noise is modeled at 52 dBA at the nearest residential receptor at night during continuous full-power transformer operation.

information_points.title: Construction transport logistics（TRAF）
information_points.content:
ACOUST-TRAF-O9T：For Castlemartin Coastal Parcel, peak daily construction vehicle trips are estimated at 90 trips/d during mobilization and heavy civil work phases.
ACOUST-TRAF-5HL：For Pembroke Industrial Brownfield, construction transport logistics evaluations indicate peak daily construction vehicle trips of 40 trips/d during site mobilization and heavy civil work phases.
ACOUST-TRAF-LUT：For Angle Bay Terminal Reserve, peak daily construction vehicle trips reach an estimated 65 trips/d during the mobilization and heavy civil work phases.
